consequence.clause joints exist: NO — shape 3 is WITHHELD
⛔ THE TABLE IS EMPTY, AND THE EMPTINESS IS THE MEASUREMENT.
Not one pool of this corpus carries a non-empty `attach` set, so not one
composed unit has a modifier, so not one unit has a shape question. This is
not a defect and it is not a gap in this script: the SHIFT REGISTER pins
`attach-set` at 0 with the idiom "EMPTY on every pool at this tip, BY
CONSTRUCTION: every shipped pool is a spine and a spine's attach set is
empty". The composed-prose model is wired and DARK.
The shape distribution therefore cannot be ruled on at 8a and the sitting
reads it when a desk section lands attach rows (8b, the defense section).
Run this script with --corpus over such a corpus to get the full table.
OWED to a named car, never silently omitted:
the THREAD verdicts
car 8a item 4 — `armThread` is chartered REPORTED until 8b's first batch
the BAND figures at the corrected grain
car 8a item 5a — the band position is a CONSTANT at the face grain (SITTING §T.5), so a band column printed here would be the same tuple on every row
the read-aloud assessment
the sitting's own act, on the strings this table prints
the claim/wiring census (A0b) after variation
